subject: Linguistics
title: The Family Tree Model
description: Learn The Family Tree Model in one minute.

hook.text: Schleicher drew the first language family tree in 1861—it looked just like Darwin's tree of species.

buildup.text: The family tree model shows how a parent language splits into daughter languages through divergence.

discovery.text: Each split represents a community separating—geographically, politically, or socially.

twist.text: The tree model struggles with contact: languages borrow from neighbors, creating web-like connections.

climax.text: Modern linguists sometimes prefer a 'wave' model that shows overlapping zones of influence.

punchline.text: Languages branch like trees—but also overlap like waves.

quiz.question: What is a limitation of the family tree model?
options: It doesn't account for language contact
